breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting boundary conditions (Neumann and Dirichlet) in the original prompt. It resolved this by omitting the incorrect Dirichlet condition and only specifying the Neumann condition (∂u/∂n = 0), which is consistent with the ground truth.
